# Hibiki Hata

> Personal site of Hibiki Hata. Curious about where technology is going. I find out by building things, measuring them, and learning.

## Writing

- [Everything I automated kept running. Everything I had to type in myself stopped.](https://hibikihata.com/writing/automated-kept-running/): why my own records stopped even with a reminder in place, and three rules I now design habits by.
- [GitHub Actions schedules ran hours late, and an hourly one rarely ran](https://hibikihata.com/writing/github-actions-schedule-reliability/): three months of run records from my own repositories, calling workflow_dispatch from an external cron instead, and what an unchanged default branch does not do to the 60-day rule.
- [rdap.org answers 404 for registered .me domains](https://hibikihata.com/writing/rdap-me-false-negative/): why an RDAP availability check can report a registered .me domain as unregistered, and how to tell the two apart.

## Things I have built

- [core-nexus](https://github.com/HibikiHata/core-nexus): personal productivity plugin for Claude Code
- [almanac-calendar](https://github.com/HibikiHata/almanac-calendar): deterministic calendar SVG, stdlib only, no external APIs
- [vault-arcade](https://obsidian.md/plugins?id=vault-arcade): Snake, 2048, Blocks, and Minesweeper inside Obsidian, keyboard or touch, offline
- [Pirate Flag](https://pirate-flag.vercel.app/): a browser tool for composing flags from parts, with shareable URLs
